7.1.description: Created infra/scripts/security-hardening.sh with fail2ban SSH/nginx configuration, UFW verification, Docker content trust, AppArmor checks, and enhanced sysctl hardening. Updated infra/nginx/default.conf with strict security headers including DENY X-Frame-Options, HSTS, CSP, and Permissions-Policy

7.2.description: Enhanced infra/scripts/backup.sh with full + incremental PostgreSQL backup (based on time of day), MinIO mc mirror to S3, GPG encryption option, rclone offsite backup to Google Drive/S3 compatible storage, restore test procedure with schema validation. Created infra/scripts/restore.sh with PostgreSQL and MinIO restore, health checks

7.3.description: Created infra/scripts/ssl-setup.sh for Certbot Let's Encrypt certificate generation with wildcard support, DNS-01 challenge via Cloudflare, auto-renewal cron job, HTTP to HTTPS redirect. Created infra/nginx/ssl.conf.template with modern TLS 1.2/1.3, OCSP stapling, SSL certificate paths, and comprehensive security headers

7.4.description: Created infra/monitoring/prometheus.yml with scrape configs for all services (node-exporter, postgres-exporter, redis-exporter, MinIO, Docker, nginx, Jitsi JVB), alertmanager config. Created infra/monitoring/grafana-dashboard.json with pre-built dashboard for Backend (request rate, latency p50/p95/p99, error rate), Database (connections, query latency), Redis (memory, hit rate), MinIO (storage, request rate), Jitsi (active conferences, participant count), System resources (CPU, memory)

7.5.description: Created docs/deployment.md with comprehensive deployment instructions including prerequisites, architecture overview, quick start (clone, env vars, docker compose, SSL, verification), security setup (SSH hardening, UFW), backup configuration (cron jobs, restore testing), monitoring setup (Grafana import, alerts), CI/CD pipeline explanation, production checklist, and troubleshooting guide

7.6.description: Updated .github/workflows/deploy.yml with test stage (npm ci, lint, typecheck, test), security-audit stage (npm audit, Trivy fs scan), build stage with Docker and Trivy container scanning, e2e-tests stage (Playwright - disabled until configured), deploy stage with pre-deployment backup, health checks, Slack notifications on success/failure, rollback on failure. Created .github/workflows/nightly-backup.yml running daily at 2AM with PostgreSQL/MinIO backup, S3 upload, rclone offsite backup, backup verification, restore integrity test, Slack notifications
